purpose: Comprehensive synthetic fixture suite for negative and boundary testing of the BHIV MasterDB aircraft data pipeline

fixtures.description: Baseline valid aircraft observation conforming to all schema, coordinate, type, and kinetic constraints
fixtures.rationale: Must pass all quality gates and be normalized into the cleaned dataset without quarantine.

fixtures.description: Observation record lacking upstream source URL and acquisition metadata
fixtures.rationale: Governance boundary: Unverified or anonymous feeds without source endpoint and timestamp must be quarantined.

fixtures.description: Payload containing string coordinate values and null required primary identifier
fixtures.rationale: Data contract enforcement: Non-numeric coordinates and missing primary keys cannot be spatialized.

fixtures.description: Batch containing duplicate ICAO transponder hex addresses
fixtures.rationale: MasterDB primary key collision: Multiple conflicting observations for the same hex ID in a discrete snapshot.

fixtures.description: Record missing mandatory geospatial coordinates and transponder identifiers
fixtures.rationale: Schema non-conformance: Records without minimum spatial state vector cannot enter governed dataset.

fixtures.description: Observations with sensor latencies > 3600s or negative latencies (clock drift anomaly)
fixtures.rationale: Temporal integrity: Stale telemetry risks stale airspace awareness; negative latency violates causality.

fixtures.description: Surface aircraft cruising at jet speed (485 kts) and heading > 360 degrees with supersonic climb rate
fixtures.rationale: Aviation domain logic: Sensor readings that violate physical flight kinematics indicate corrupted transponder data.
